newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Heavy in China ship engine joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Korea Heavy in China ship engine joint venture.

text.p: The government-run Korea Heavy Industries and Construction Corp said on Wednesday it had agreed in principle with China State Ship-building Corp to set up a joint venture in Shanghai to produce ship engines.
Korea Heavy said in a statement it would invest $20 million in the joint venture, in which its stake will be 49 percent, and the Chinese company will hold the remainder.
The joint venture plans to begin producing 40 to 50 units of diesel-fuelled engines, each with a capacity of one million horsepower, from 1999, the statement said.
